Rashi on Arakhin 14a:1:1.hebrew: מילתא אגב אורחיה קמ"ל - דלא תנא את הנאה שבכנענים, לפי שאסור להזכיר שם נוי על כנעני, כדרב יהודה, דכתיב (דברים ז) לא תחנם — לא תתן להם חן:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:1:1.english: It teaches us a matter in passing - That [the Tanna] did not teach "the most attractive among the Canaanites" [is] because it is forbidden to mention an expression of beauty regarding a Canaanite, in accordance with [the statement of] Rav Yehuda, as it is written (Deuteronomy 7): "You shall show them no mercy" — do not grant them favor.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:3:1.english: But isn't it taught - Regarding a rapist and a seducer.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:3:2.english: The lowest among the Israelites and the highest in the priesthood - Evidently, [the tanna] is dealing with two lineages.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:4:1.hebrew: בעובד כוכבים לא משכחת לה - דין שדה אחוזה, שיהא פודהו בחמשים שקל כסף, אלא בשויו — דלאו בני אחוזה בארץ ישראל נינהו:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:4:1.english: With regard to an idolater, you do not find it - [Namely,] the law of an ancestral field, that he should redeem it for fifty silver shekels; rather, [it is redeemed] at its value — for they are not holders of ancestral land in the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:5:2.hebrew: פרדיסות סבסטי - כרמים של אותו מקום, ומעולים הם מאוד:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:5:2.english: The orchards of Sebastia - Vineyards of that place, and they are of very high quality.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:5:3.hebrew: נותן - מי שפודה אותם, בין בעלים בין אדם אחר, בבית זרע חומר שעורים חמשים שקל כסף, אם תחלת היובל היה; ואם לא — מגרע לפי השנים שעברו, סלע ופונדיון לשנה, כדכתיב קרא:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:5:3.english: Gives - Whoever redeems them, whether the owner or another person, [gives] fifty silver shekels for an area required for sowing a chomer of barley, if it was [at] the beginning of the Jubilee; and if not, he deducts according to the years that have passed, a sela and a pundeyon per year, as the verse states:

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:6:1.english: Both an ancestral field, etc. - For all of them are redeemed for fifty shekels.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:6:2.hebrew: שדה אחוזה - אם בעלים פודין אותה, מוסיפין חומש על החמישים, כדכתיב (ויקרא כ״ז:י״ט) ואם גאל יגאל את השדה המקדיש וגו':
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:6:2.english: An ancestral field - If the owner redeems it, he adds a fifth to the fifty [shekels], as it is written (Leviticus 27:19): "And if he who consecrated the field will redeem it, etc."

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:6:3.english: And in [the case of] a purchased field one does not give a fifth - As is explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:7:1.hebrew: בעין יפה מקדיש - אילנות לבד וקרקע לבד, ולא שיפדה אילנות אגב קרקע:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:7:1.english: [He] consecrates with a generous eye - The trees separately and the land separately, and not that he may redeem the trees along with the land.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:8:1.hebrew: פרדיסות - היינו כרמים נטועים, וקתני חמשים שקל — אלמא נפדין אילנות אגב קרקע:
Rashi on Arakhin 14a:8:1.english: Orchards - That is, planted vineyards, and [the mishna] teaches [that one gives] fifty shekels; evidently, trees are redeemed along with the land.

Rashi on Arakhin 14a:8:2.english: Suitable - And it is not planted.

Tosafot on Arakhin 13b:17:2.hebrew: (שייך לדף י"ד ע"א) מה בין שדה מקנה לשדה אחוזה כו' - והוא הדין דהוה מצי למימר חילוק אחר בין שדה אחוזה לשדה מקנה: שבשדה אחוזה, אם הקדישו וגאלו אחר — מתחלק לכהנים ביובל; ובשדה מקנה, אם הקדישו וגאלו אחר — חוזר לבעלים ביובל. ולא נחת לפרושי אלא חילוק דשייך כשהוא עצמו פודהו:
Tosafot on Arakhin 13b:17:2.english: ([This comment] belongs to page 14a) "What is the difference between a purchased field and an ancestral field, etc." - And the same is true, that [the Tanna] could have stated another distinction between an ancestral field and a purchased field: that in [the case of] an ancestral field, if he consecrated it and another [person] redeemed it, it is distributed to the priests in the Jubilee; and in [the case of] a purchased field, if he consecrated it and another [person] redeemed it, it returns to the [original] owner in the Jubilee. And [the Tanna] set out to explain only a distinction that applies when he himself redeems it.

Tosafot on Arakhin 14a:4:1.hebrew: בעובד כוכבים לא משכחת - משום דלאו בני אחוזה נינהו. ואע"ג דאמרינן (קדושין דף יז:): "עובד כוכבים יורש אביו דבר תורה", מ"מ לא היה להם אחוזה בארץ; ודין זה לא שייך כי אם בא"י, דמצוה היא התלויה בארץ, ועובד כוכבים אין לו נחלה בארץ:
Tosafot on Arakhin 14a:4:1.english: "In [the case of] a gentile you do not find [it]" - Because they are not subject to [the law of] an ancestral holding. And even though we say (Kiddushin 17b): "A gentile inherits [from] his father by Torah law," nevertheless, they had no ancestral holding in the Land; and this law applies only in Eretz Yisrael, for it is a mitzvah that is dependent on the Land, and a gentile has no inheritance in the Land.
